referral.reason_text: Abnormal LFTs on private test, now progressive dysphagia over 5 weeks with rapid worsening. OGD normal in October.

deciding.fast_track_met: Progressive dysphagia is recorded in the symptom list with onset 2024-02-12 and the dysphagia box is ticked, which meets the criterion.
deciding.vetting_outcome: The referral is complete in its history and symptoms, and the OGD from October was normal, so it can be booked as a routine slot.
deciding.first_contact: The LFT question and the normal OGD in October can be answered by written guidance without seeing the patient.
deciding.clinical_urgency: Rapid worsening dysphagia with 5 kg weight loss and vomiting is not explained by the October OGD. No bloods are available, so level 3 is not firmly shown and level 2 is defensible.
deciding.record_agreement: The only difference is the name spelling Thomas against Tomas Reyes. Age, symptoms and history agree.
